subject: URG: Candidate stranded on ferry — propose compressed 30m interview block / remote
messages:
From: Alex Soto <alex.soto@example.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>; Hiring Panel <hiring-panel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Interview with Redwood (Nov 22) — running late

Hi Jordan / team,

I'm really sorry — my commuter ferry hit mechanical trouble and we're delayed. Operator says ETA to dock is ~60-90 minutes. I'm en route but will definitely miss the 9:30 slot. If possible I can wait and join remotely later this morning, or we could condense the sessions into a single 30-minute remote block. I can be available by 10:30 PT if that works.

Attaching my resume in case it helps for a condensed interview.

Thanks for understanding — Alex
(Attachment: alex_soto_resume.pdf)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Soto <alex.soto@example.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T08:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Interview with Redwood (Nov 22) — running late

Thanks for the heads-up Alex — really appreciate you letting us know.

Panel, quick ask: Alex can do ~10:30 PT (about 60 mins from now). To keep the day moving, can we compress the scheduled 60–75m loop into a single 30-minute remote session focused on the core system-design + one coding walkthrough? Proposed slot: 10:30–11:00 PT, Google Meet link to follow.

If 10:30 doesn't work for people, alternative is to move the full loop to later in the afternoon but that will push other interviews. Naomi / Irene — can one of you take the combined session, and split notes coverage? Marissa — can you send the quick interviewer guide and confirm whether we need the take-home waived?

I dropped a short guide and Alex's resume into thread for quick context.

(Attachment: interviewer_quick_guide.docx)

Next steps: confirm availability and I'll create the 30m invite and share the Meet link.

—Jordan
Senior Recruiter | Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>; Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Soto <alex.soto@example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Interview with Redwood (Nov 22) — running late

Jordan — I can do the 10:30–11:00 PT compressed block. I suggest this agenda:
- 10:30–10:45: system design deep-dive (high level + one concrete tradeoff)
- 10:45–10:55: quick live coding / algorithm question (pairing on a small prompt)
- 10:55–11:00: culture fit + next steps

I can cover both system design and the coding prompt; Irene can take notes and handle follow-up scheduling if we need a second pass.

Confirming I'm remote-ready with Meet and screen-share.

—Naomi
Staff Engineer, Platform
From: Alex Soto <alex.soto@example.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Interview with Redwood (Nov 22) — running late

Thanks Jordan / Naomi — 10:30–11:00 PT works for me. Appreciate the agenda; that sounds fair. I'll be on my laptop and on mobile hotspot if the ferry Wi-Fi is flaky, but I can call in if necessary.

See you at 10:30 (link when ready).

Alex
(Attachment: alex_soto_mobile_contact.txt)
